Introduction






The office of Controller of Examinations is an integral part of the university to supervise the university examinations and evaluation processes for the same. The controller of examination is the head of this office under whose supervision all exam related works have been carried out with prior approval from the competent authority. This office is responsible for all the required arrangement to conduct the End Semester Examinations and Supplementary Examinations, if required. It also facilitates evaluation of answer scripts centrally, then tabulation of marks and declaration of results.










Responsibilities








To notify the examination related information to all the concerned as per requirement.



Appointment of Officer In-Charge and other members of the Examination committee.
Appointment of external supervisors for end semester practical examinations.
To conduct the Ph.D. entrance test (RET) and course work examination.
Facilitating the revaluation process of answer-scripts whenever required.
Issuing regular or duplicate Grade sheets, Provisional Pass Certificates, Transcripts etc. as per the eligibility of the students.
Recommending award of degrees to the qualified candidates of different programs at the convocation.
Providing services like qualification verification and genuineness of degrees etc. to various stakeholders.

title: AdtU: A Premier Education Destination
text:
Assam down town University
Empowering Education in North East India























About Us
Assam down town University has been a pioneer of modern global education that inspires its students to think critically, learn across disciplinary boundaries, engage in research and focus on values of highest order. The journey of the university started with down town Charity Trust that established this institution in 2010 nestled in the scenic surroundings of Panikhaiti, Chandrapur, Guwahati. It had resolved to provide affordable quality education to the people of the North Eastern Region of India. Since then, this university has worked its ways to become a beacon of modern education and innovation. The pioneering education provided at AdtU has expanded across the world as students as far as African countries like Zimbabwe, Kenya and neighbouring counties like Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh among others have enrolled in this institution. Education at AdtU puts a strong emphasis on foundational knowledge, excellent professional communication, innovation academic rigour and research. Our students are encouraged to explore diverse disciplinary ideas and become well-rounded professionals who can be committed leaders.























A Vision for Excellence




Celebrating Diversity and Excellence




A Journey of Excellence




















The journey of Assam down town University began in 2010 with a resolute mission to address the region's need for accessible and quality education. Over the years the education at AdtU has become more global in nature as our programmes provide holistic professional education fit for the real-world challenges.
The Campus at AdtU located by the serenely beautiful Brahmaputra is an eclectic hub of social, cultural and intellectual activities. The university makes sure that students nurture their passions through diverse clubs that of art, music, dance, yoga, and robotics and so on while striving for academic excellence.
AdtU stands out for its distinctive approach of merging academic prowess with industry insights. This fusion equips students with a holistic understanding of their chosen fields. The education at AdtU has an increasing focus on the emerging dynamics of the professional world and on nurturing young individuals who will fit into it and flourish.
The university has assembled a team of experienced faculty members, blending industry veterans and renowned academicians. Their guidance shapes students into future leaders.






























Cultural Mosaic: AdtU's student community reflects diversity, with individuals hailing from various parts of India and abroad. This multicultural environment fosters an inclusive and rich learning experience.

Modern Teaching Methods: The university places a strong emphasis on contemporary teaching methods, ensuring that students are equipped with relevant skills to excel in their chosen careers.
Industry Integration: AdtU's industry ties facilitate real-world exposure, internships, and placements. This seamless integration ensures that students are job-ready upon graduation.
Accolades and Achievements: The pursuit of academic excellence has garnered AdtU numerous accolades. Today, it stands as a top-ranked university in the North East, with a reputation for quality education.






























Diverse
Disciplines:AdtU's academic umbrella spans a wide range of
disciplines, including Sciences, Engineering, Allied Health Sciences, Management, Social
Sciences, Humanities, Nursing, and Pharmacy.
Innovative Pedagogy:
The university employs an inspirational academic model, aligned with
global standards. It consistently evolves to match the dynamic landscape of education
and international practices.
Global Footprints:
With a global perspective in mind, AdtU encourages students to
participate in research initiatives, exchange programs, and collaborations with
international institutions.
Campus Infrastructure:
Spread across more than 50 acres of land serene Panikhaiti, the
university boasts state-of-the-art infrastructure, creating an ideal environment for
holistic education.







































The Journey to University Status
Government Recognition: down town Charity Trust's endeavor was officially recognized by the Assam Government. In 2010, the educational project in Panikhaiti received university status, a milestone marked by Assam Gazette No.LGL.9/2010/11.

Private University Pioneer: This recognition positioned Assam down town University as the second private university in the state of Assam, contributing significantly to the region's educational landscape.











In the heart of the North Eastern Region of India, Assam down town University stands tall as a testament to quality, accessibility, and innovation in education. With a commitment to merging academia and industry, fostering diversity, and consistently striving for excellence, AdtU has become a preferred choice for those seeking holistic education in Assam.

Overview







The Directorate of Career Advancement plays a pivotal role in guiding students through their professional journeys by addressing various facets of career development comprehensively. Placement and training are integral to our mission, as we collaborate closely with companies to facilitate successful campus recruitment drives. We prepare students through pre-placement training, which includes mock interviews, group discussions, aptitude and domain training, and workshops on resume-building and company-specific training. Our industry-specific programs ensure students are job-ready, equipped with both technical and essential soft skills necessary for thriving in the workplace. We encourage students to gain practical experience through internships during their academic journey, providing invaluable insights into real-world scenarios and industry practices through our extensive network of industry partners. This exposure allows students to build professional networks, apply classroom knowledge practically, and enhance their overall learning experience. We assist students in exploring higher education opportunities both within India and abroad, offering guidance on suitable institutions, application processes, and available scholarships, complemented by seminars, workshops, and interactive sessions about diverse fields of study, entrance exams, and admission requirements through our study abroad partners. Recognizing the significance of competitive exams, we offer specialized coaching and resources for exams such as civil services and banking, including mock tests, study materials, and expert-led workshops designed to enhance students' chances of success through our partners. Career counseling is a cornerstone of our services, where our team and external career consultants offer personalized guidance through one-on-one sessions, helping students identify their strengths, interests, and career goals while providing insights into different career paths, industry trends, and emerging fields. Our aim is to align students' aspirations with suitable career trajectories and equip them with the knowledge needed for successful professional lives. The Directorate of Career Advancement is committed to empowering students with the tools and confidence to excel in their professional endeavors, fostering a future of success and fulfillment.














Vision & Mission



Vision
To empower students with the knowledge, skills, and opportunities necessary
to achieve
holistic career success, shaping industry-ready professionals equipped to thrive in dynamic
academic & professional environments.





Mission
The Directorate of Career Advancement will empower students with job
opportunities, providing
seamless access to rewarding careers. It will offer hands-on training and internships to
bridge academics and professional needs. The Directorate will also guide students in
exploring higher education opportunities, provide personalized career counseling, and
support excellence in competitive exams, helping them achieve academic and professional
success.

The evolving paradigms in education necessitate academic institutions to cultivate a new
generation of professionals—individuals endowed with comprehensive knowledge, technical
skills, innovative thinking, and the ability to approach problems creatively. Industry
expectations have escalated, demanding individuals who possess the right attitude and
skills to embrace challenges and enhance their performance continually. Success now
requires not only hard work but also smart and consistent efforts.
With over a decade of distinguished existence as a premier university in Northeast India,
Assam down town University (AdtU) has established itself by securing job opportunities
for students in prestigious and reputed firms, thus ensuring a promising start to their
careers. As a leader in imparting professional management education in the region, AdtU
boasts an exceptional track record of placements. This accomplishment reflects the
university's academic rigor and the outstanding aptitude and quality of its students. It
underscores the trust and confidence the corporate world places in AdtU and its
students.
The university places special emphasis on instilling corporate values and skills required
for complex decision-making, alongside developing superior expertise in functional
domains and acquiring business knowledge. The placement and training programs play a
crucial role in this endeavor, conducting industry expert talks, skill development
workshops, industrial projects, and training in soft skills and aptitude.
We extend our sincere gratitude to all stakeholders involved in this process, whose
unwavering support and assistance have been instrumental in its effective completion. We
express our heartfelt appreciation to all the recruiters who have demonstrated immense
faith in the competencies and aptitude of our students. We also extend our thanks to our
esteemed faculty members, students, and illustrious alumni, who have been a great source
of support and encouragement in the smooth conduct of the placement process.
As we commence our final placements, we warmly welcome all campus recruiters to Assam
down town University. We look forward to establishing a deeper, more robust, and
mutually beneficial relationship with your esteemed organization. If you seek
exceptional talent, AdtU stands as one of the finest choices to meet your expectations
and contribute to your human resource talent pool.

Regards,Dr. Rimjhim Baruah BorahAssociate Director (i/c)Directorate

Campus Placement Drive
The Campus Placement Drive at Assam Down Town University is
a significant event that aims to bridge the gap between academic learning and
professional opportunities for students. This initiative invites a diverse range
of companies from various industries to the campus, providing students with a
platform to showcase their skills and secure employment. Through pre-placement
talks, interviews, and skill assessments, students gain valuable exposure to the
corporate world and increase their chances of securing job offers. The
university's strong emphasis on industry connections and student development
ensures a high success rate for placements, making it a pivotal part of the
student experience.
View
Report















Summer Internship
Directorate of Career Advancement provide students with
practical experience and exposure in their respective fields. These internships
are designed to complement academic learning with hands-on experience in
real-world settings. During these programs, students have the opportunity to
work on projects, participate in industry activities, and gain valuable insights
from professionals. The internships help in enhancing students' skills, boosting
their resumes, and preparing them for future career opportunities.














Industrial Visits
Industrial visits organized by Directorate of Career
Advancement and the respective Faculty of Studies at Assam down town University
offer students a practical perspective on their academic learning. These visits
are integral to the curriculum, providing an opportunity to observe real-world
applications of theoretical knowledge. Students visit various industries, engage
with professionals, and gain insights into industry operations, technology, and
best practices. This hands-on experience not only enhances their understanding
but also prepares them for future careers by bridging the gap between classroom
education and the demands of the professional world.















HR Conclave
The HR Conclave organized by the Directorate of Career
Advancement is a prestigious event and one of its kind in the northeast India
that brings together industry leaders, HR professionals, and academicians to
discuss the latest trends, challenges, and innovations in human resource
management. The conclave serves as a platform for networking, knowledge sharing,
and exploring opportunities for collaboration between the corporate sector and
academia. Through insightful panel discussions, keynote speeches, and
interactive sessions, participants gain valuable insights into the evolving
landscape of HR practices and strategies for career advancement.















Job Fair
The Directorate of Career Advancement at Assam down town
University organize a Job Fair each year since 9 years which is aimed at
bridging the gap between AdtU students, Alumni & non AdtU students and potential
employers. This event provided a platform for students to explore diverse career
opportunities, engage with industry professionals, and gain insights into the
current job market trends. Various reputed companies participated, offering
internships, full-time positions, and valuable networking opportunities. The
fair was a significant step towards enhancing the employability of the
university's graduates and strengthening the university's connections with the
corporate sector.















Edu Fair
An Education Fair is organized, aimed at providing students
with extensive career guidance and opportunities. The fair featured
representatives from various educational institutions, companies, and
industries, offering insights into different career paths. Attendees had the
chance to engage in interactive sessions, workshops, and one-on-one
consultations with experts. The event also included presentations on emerging
career trends, skill development, and higher education opportunities, making it
an invaluable resource for students planning their academic and professional
futures.

Career counselling at Assam down town University plays a crucial role in shaping
students professional journeys by offering expert guidance, industry insights,
and skill development opportunities. Additionally, AdtU supports students in
preparing for competitive exams by emphasizing dedication, time management, and

By integrating career counselling with competitive exam preparation, AdtU
ensures that students are equipped with the confidence, knowledge, and skills

Placement SOP





Objective

In the dynamic landscape of Assam down town
University, the Directorate of Career
Advancement stands as a catalyst for
transforming academic potential into promising
professional trajectories. Committed to guiding
and empowering students on their journey from
classrooms to careers, the Directorate of Career
Advancement at Assam down town University is a
pivotal hub where
aspirations converge with opportunities.

Student Database Preparation: Details from individual students
are gathered to create a comprehensive student database.
Resume Collection: Resumes are gathered from all students for
documentation and presentation to potential employers.
Nomination of Placement Coordinators: Each course designates a
student placement coordinator and a faculty placement coordinator, nominated by
respective Deans. They collaborate with the Directorate of Career Advancement
for the seamless execution of placement drives.
Finishing School Training: Students undergo training sessions
in soft skills, aptitude & domain training to enhance their preparedness for
placements.
Campus Placement Invitations: Invitations for campus placement
are extended to various organizations to participate in campus placement drives
physically or in virtual mode.
Receiving of Job Description & Notifying Students:
Organizations email comprehensive job descriptions, which are then notified and
circulated among the students.
Campus Placement Drive Arrangements: Campus placement drive is
organized after compiling a list of interested and eligible students. Logistical
arrangements are also made for the recruiters.
Campus Placement Drive Conduction: Students actively engage in
the campus drive, striving to successfully navigate all interview rounds and
secure placements.
Sharing Selection Mail / Offer Letters to Placed Students:
Successfully selected students receive official offer letters from the
recruiting organizations.
Facilitation of Joining Process: The Directorate of Career
Advancement manages the joining process to ensure a smooth transition for
students, minimizing any potential difficulties they may encounter.

shall come

Internship SOP





Objective
Internships provide university students with valuable opportunities to gain
practical, hands-on
experience in their chosen fields of study. These structured practical exposure,
often aligned with
academic interests, allow students to apply classroom knowledge to real-world
scenarios.
Internships serve as a bridge between academic learning and professional practice,
enabling
students to develop essential skills, build industry networks, and explore potential
career paths.
Internships are a pivotal component of a holistic education, offering students a
glimpse into their
future professions and preparing them for the demands of the workforce.


Students are encouraged to arrange their own internships by contacting
organizations and
obtaining confirmation letters.
If students are unable to secure an internship, the Directorate of Career
Advancement assists in
arranging one
The students have to write an application to the Directorate of Career
Advancement through the
concerned department and attach the confirmation from the organization.
Specifically for Faculty
of Paramedical Sciences & Faculty of Physiotherapy students who have
successfully cleared all
the semesters are eligible for internship & have to submit an application to the
Directorate of
Career Advancement through their concerned department, attaching all required
documents (e.g.,
semester result sheets/mark sheets and confirmation from the organization),
which are then
verified by the examination department.

The Directorate of Career Advancement verifies the documents and issues the
Internship Letter.

Students submit the Internship Letter to the organization and commence their
internship

Objective
Assam down town University organize a dynamic and impactful job fair each year,
providing a pivotal
platform for students and companies to connect and explore mutually beneficial

hosted by the Directorate of Career Advancement, was designed to bridge the gap

and the professional world, offering a diverse array of career prospects for

Securing Necessary Approvals for Hosting the Job Fair:

ensuring compliance with institutional and external guidelines for a seamless
event.

Sharing Job Fair Proposal To Organizations: The Directorate of

Notifying Marketing Team for Promotion: Informing the marketing

emails, and posters, to maximize event visibility and participation.
Contacting Companies for Vacancy Information: Reaching out to
companies to gather and compile detailed vacancy information, ensuring a wide
range of opportunities for job-seeking candidates.
Job Fair Notification to Departments & Students of AdtU:
Notifying all departments and students of AdtU about the Job Fair, encouraging
participation and providing necessary details.
Job Fair Notification to Educational Institutes of the Region:
Informing nearby educational institutes about the Job Fair, inviting their

Students Registration at AdtU Portal: Job-seeking candidates
must register for the Job Fair on the university portal through a registration
link or QR code.
Admit Card Issuance for Registered Students: Admit cards are
generated and distributed to registered students.
Venue Setup & Other Logistical Arrangements: Arrangement of
venue and other logistical requirements are done.
Job Fair Conduction: Organizations and job-seeking candidates
participate in the Job Fair at the university campus and receive job offers.

Career Counselling SOP





Objective
The objective of the Directorate of Career Advancement is to assist individuals in
making informed and meaningful decisions about their career paths and to empower
individuals to take control of their professional lives, achieve personal
fulfillment, and contribute meaningfully to society through their work. Career
counselling at the Directorate of Career Advancement follows a structured process
aimed at guiding students towards informed career decisions and successful
professional paths:


A general counselling assessment is conducted to understand students' strengths,
interests, personality traits, and career aspirations. This initial step helps
in identifying potential career paths that align with their profiles.
An assessment is conducted for students who are nominated by the deans to
conduct 1-to-1 Career Counselling Sessions. Based on the assessment, clear
career goals are established in collaboration with the students. This step
involves discussing short-term and long-term career objectives and outlining
steps to achieve them.
We provide information on various career options, industries, and emerging
fields. Students are exposed to diverse opportunities through seminars,
workshops, and interactions with industry experts.
Our counselors assist students in evaluating the pros and cons of different
career paths and making informed decisions. Factors such as job prospects,
growth opportunities, and personal interests are considered during this phase.

A personalized career development plan is formulated, outlining actionable steps
towards achieving career goals. This plan may include further education, skill
development, networking strategies, and gaining relevant experience through
internships.
Continuous support is provided throughout the career development process.
Counselors offer guidance on resume writing, interview preparation, and
networking. Follow-up sessions help students stay on track and adapt their plans
as needed.
Periodic evaluation helps assess progress towards career goals and make
necessary adjustments. Feedback from internships or job applications is used to
refine career strategies and enhance employability.


Approval and Implementation
The proposed Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been reviewed and is hereby
approved for implementation with the esteemed consent of the Hon’ble Vice
Chancellor. This SOP shall come into effect immediately and must be adhered to by
all relevant stakeholders to ensure compliance and efficiency in operations.

























Competitive Exam SOP





Objective
The objective of the Directorate of Career Advancement is to empower students to
excel in competitive exams by providing comprehensive guidance, resources, and
training. The Directorate aims to bridge the gap between academic learning and exam
requirements, ensuring students are well-prepared to achieve top ranks and secure
admissions to prestigious institutions or career opportunities. Through structured
programs, mentorship, and access to quality study materials, the Placement Cell
strives to enhance students' conceptual understanding, problem-solving skills, and
confidence to succeed in highly competitive environments.

Some Comprehensive outline of our approach

We begin by assessing each student's current knowledge, skills, and exam
readiness through diagnostic assessment and discussions. Clear goals are set
based on the specific exam they are preparing for.
MOU tie-ups are done with various organizations such as T.I.M.E, SPM Academy,
Career Launcher, and Competitive Care, which provide customized study plans.

Students have access to a wide range of study materials, including textbooks,
practice questions, previous years' papers, and online resources.
Experienced faculty members conduct specialized coaching sessions tailored to
each exam, covering concepts, problem-solving strategies, and time management
techniques.
Regular mock tests simulate the actual test environment, helping students
improve speed and accuracy.
Detailed feedback and performance analysis are provided after each mock test to
help students adjust their study plans.
Workshops and seminars are organized to enhance students' quantitative aptitude,
logical reasoning, verbal ability, and general awareness.
Special attention is given to exam-specific strategies such as tackling
multiple-choice questions effectively and stress management.
Students receive continuous support, motivation, and mentoring from faculty
members and counselors.
Post-exam guidance is provided on application processes, interview preparation,
and career counseling.


Approval and Implementation
The proposed Standard Operation Procedure (SOP) has been reviewed and is hereby
approved for implementation with the esteemed consent of the Hon’ble Vice
Chancellor. This SOP shall come into effect immediately and must be adhered to by
all relevant stakeholders to ensure compliance and efficiency in operations.























Higher Studies SOP






Objective
The objective of the Directorate of Career Advancement for Higher Education is to
empower students to pursue advanced academic opportunities by providing
comprehensive guidance, resources, and support for higher education admissions. It
aims to assist students in identifying suitable programs, preparing for entrance
exams, and navigating the application process for universities and institutions
worldwide. Through mentorship, workshops, and collaborations, the Directorate of
Career Advancement strives to enhance students' academic and professional prospects,
enabling them to achieve their aspirations in higher education and beyond.

In India: The department provides information on various higher
education options within the country, including courses, institutions, entrance
exams, and application procedures.
Abroad: The department also assists students interested in
studying abroad by offering information on international universities,
scholarships, standardized tests (like GRE, TOEFL, etc.), and visa application
processes.
The Directorate of Career Advancement conducts workshops and seminars on
preparing for competitive exams, writing effective SOPs, improving interview
skills, and understanding global educational trends.
The Directorate of Career Advancement facilitates networking opportunities with
alumni, industry professionals, and recruiters and conducts Corporate Guest
Lectures to help students build professional connections and gain insights into
different career fields by conducting Education Fairs.
The Directorate of Career Advancement also provides scholarship options
available for pursuing higher education, both domestically and internationally.

Overview


The Central Library (HariNarayan Dutta Baruah Central Library),
Assam down town University was established in the year 2010 with the main motto of fulfilling
the essential knowledge needs of the students, faculties, and research scholars and staff of the
university. The Central Library functions with great precision and dedication to promote
academic excellence.


Library Location


The Central Library is located in the “K Block” named as Bornadi which
is near to the temple area in the university campus. The Library is spread over four floors of
the building.

who can contribute towards socio-economic development.

The mission of the library is to preserve knowledge and to disseminate this among the users.
HNDB Central Library works as a knowledge hub for the scholarly community.

The HNDB Central Library features an extensive array of specialized collections catering to diverse interests. The Competitive Section offers vital resources for exam preparation, while the Mythology Section preserves ancient religious texts like the Vedas and the Quran. The Children Section fosters a love for reading among young readers, and the Music Section serves as a haven for music enthusiasts and researchers. The Banga-Bandhu Section, a gift from Bangladesh, includes international books and photographs. The Hari Narayan Dutta Baruah Section houses works by the celebrated author. The library also offers a vast collection of Sanskrit texts, the Pt. Deendayal Upadhyay collections, and over 100 rare books spanning various subjects. Unique collections feature local historical artifacts and vintage records. The Manuscript Section contains digitized Chitra Bhagawata and traditional manuscripts. The Braille Section supports visually impaired readers, while the Alumni Section fosters lifelong learning and camaraderie among alumni.













PRAN is an institutional library management software (ILMS) of Assam down town University. It streamlines library operations, encompassing cataloging, circulation, acquisition, and serial management, ensuring efficient and organized library workflows. The software integrates user-friendly interfaces and robust search functionalities, allowing users to easily access and manage a vast collection of academic resources. By leveraging modern technology, PRAN significantly enhances the overall library experience, facilitating improved resource management and accessibility for the university's academic community.

Campus Facilities
Our university is committed to providing an exceptional educational facilities through its advanced and comprehensive campus facilities. From state-of-the-art laboratories and ICT-enabled classrooms to modern seminar halls and a central library, we ensure students have access to cutting-edge facilities that support both learning and research. Additionally, our well-equipped sports and gym facilities, comfortable hostels, and robust healthcare services contribute to a well-rounded and enriching campus experience. Emphasizing sustainability, our green campus and innovative media centre foster a vibrant and forward-thinking academic community.












ICT Enabled Classrooms
Our university boasts of ICT-enabled classrooms, transforming the educational landscape with cutting-edge technology. These classrooms are equipped with interactive whiteboards, digital projectors, and internet-connected devices, creating an engaging and interactive learning environment. Students benefit from multimedia presentations, real-time collaboration, and access to a vast array of online resources, enhancing their learning experience.

Read more












Well Equipped Laboratories
Assam down town University proudly showcases cutting-edge laboratories across various disciplines, providing students with unparalleled hands-on, practical experience. The laboratories of Faculty of Science with state-of-the-art facilities enable cutting-edge research and experimentation, fostering a deep understanding of fundamental principles. The Nursing and Paramedical departments feature simulation labs that provide realistic clinical scenarios, preparing students for real-world medical challenges with advanced equipment and technology.

Read more












Auditorium & Seminar Halls
Our university takes pride in offering top-tier seminar halls and auditoriums, meticulously crafted to support a diverse range of academic and extracurricular activities. Each block features its own modern auditoriums, providing ample space for lectures, presentations, and cultural events. Outfitted with cutting-edge audio-visual technology, these auditoriums ensure a seamless and engaging experience for both speakers and attendees. Additionally, our Engineering laboratories are outfitted with the latest machinery and tools, allowing students to ...

Read more












Central Library
The HNDB Central Library (Hari Narayan Dutta Baruah Central Library) at Assam down town University was established in 2010 with the primary goal of fulfilling the knowledge needs of students, faculty, research scholars, and staff. Dedicated to promoting academic excellence, the HNDB Central Library operates with great precision and commitment. Located in the “K Block” near the swimming pool and temple area on campus, the library spans three floors.Named after the renowned writer and publisher Sahityaratna late Hari Narayan Dutta Baruah, the library was founded in 2010.

Read more











Hostels
Our campus at Assam down town University offers comfortable accommodation and dining facilities to support student life. We provide separate hostels for girls and boys, ensuring a safe and conducive living environment. Each hostel is equipped with modern amenities and supervised by dedicated staff to cater to the needs of our diverse student community.

Read more











Canteen & Cafeterias
Every block on campus features canteens where students can enjoy a variety of nutritious meals and snacks. These canteens are conveniently located to serve students during their study breaks and leisure time. In addition to the canteens, our campus boasts several cafeterias offering a range of dining options, from quick bites to wholesome meals, enhancing the dining experience for all members of our university community.

Read more











Sports Facilities
Sports facilities at the university cater to students, faculty members, and staff, offering a diverse range of indoor and outdoor activities for all skill levels. Our campus is home to a variety of indoor games including pool board, badminton, table tennis, carom, chess, ludo, and arm wrestling, providing opportunities for recreation and friendly competition among the university community. These indoor facilities complement our outdoor amenities, which include a basketball court, football field, futsal court, swimming pool, volleyball court, kabaddi ground, and a cutting-edge cricket ground.

Read more












Gym Facilities
AdtU features state-of-the-art fitness center equipped with modern gym equipment, ensuring year-round exercise options in a controlled environment. These spaces are where students embark on a spirited sporting journey that runs parallel to their academic endeavors. This amenity promotes physical health, foster social interaction, and build a sense of community among the university members, enhancing the overall campus experience.

Read more











Transport Facilities
The university campus boasts comprehensive transport facilities designed to ensure convenience and accessibility for students, faculty, and staff. A fleet of well-maintained buses operates on multiple routes, covering all major areas of the city and neighbouring regions, providing reliable and efficient transportation to and from the campus. In addition to the bus service, the campus features dedicated shuttle services that facilitate easy movement within the campus, connecting academic buildings, dormitories, sports complexes, and dining areas. Ample parking spaces are available for those commuting by car and ...

Read more











Healthcare Facilities
The university campus is equipped with comprehensive healthcare facilities to ensure the well-being of students, faculty, and staff. The on-campus health centre provides a wide range of medical services, including general consultations, emergency care, and mental health support. Staffed by experienced doctors, nurses, and counsellors, the centre is dedicated to addressing both physical and mental health needs. Additionally, the campus pharmacy offers prescription and over-the-counter medications, along with health and wellness products.

Read more












Green Campus
The university prides itself on being a green campus, committed to sustainability and environmental stewardship. Lush greenery, well-maintained gardens, and tree-lined pathways create a serene and picturesque environment, providing a refreshing contrast to urban life. Water conservation initiatives, including rainwater harvesting and efficient irrigation systems, the use of renewable energy sources like solar panels further support the campus's sustainability goals. Various student-led environmental clubs and initiatives promote awareness and active participation in green practices...

Read more












Campus Ambience
AdtU's campus offers a unique and inviting ambience, seamlessly blending natural beauty with modern infrastructure to create an inspiring environment for learning and growth. Nestled amidst lush greenery, the campus features well-maintained gardens, tree-lined pathways, and tranquil water bodies that provide a peaceful retreat from the bustling city life. The thoughtfully designed architecture includes state-of-the-art academic buildings, comfortable residential halls, and vibrant common areas that foster a sense of community.

Read more











Media Centre Facilities
AdtU's Media Centre stands as a beacon of creativity and innovation. Students benefit from access to high-definition cameras, professional audio equipment, and advanced editing software, fostering hands-on experience in photography, virtual reality projects, and podcast production. The centre’s collaborative workspaces encourage interdisciplinary collaboration, while the  digital library provide essential resources for research and inspiration. Guided by experienced faculty and technical staff, students refine their skills in media ...

Read more











Yoga Center
AdtU provides a dedicated yoga center, led by trained professionals, for the benefit of the students and faculties. The university recognizes that yoga is more than just a fitness routine or a tool for mental well-being; it is a profound ancient discipline that promotes holistic growth. By encouraging the practice of modern yoga, AdtU aims to help students cultivate balanced behavior and a vibrant personality, ultimately guiding them toward achieving a higher state of consciousness.

Read more











ATM Facility
AdtU offers on-campus ATM facility for the convenience of students, faculties, and staffs which is located near cafeteria and can be easily identified.This facility enables students to manage their finances effortlessly, eliminating the need to leave the university grounds for banking needs.

Overview







The Directorate of International Affairs at AdtU takes pleasure in its
role as a catalyst for worldwide collaboration and the expansion of international possibilities
for both students and faculty members. Although the University was established in 2010, our
journey to substantial worldwide involvement officially began in 2020, signifying a crucial
turning point in our efforts to reach out to the world.
AdtU has developed strong relationships with more than 50 prestigious
foreign universities, facilitating cross-disciplinary collaborations.These alliances have paved
the way for numerous joint projects, including faculty and student exchange programs, cultural
exchanges, team research projects, seminars, and other academic activities. AdtU fosters a
vibrant international environment, with an aim to prepare our community for advancement and
growth in a world that is rapidly promoting interconnectivity.
The Directorate of International Affairs actively promotes
internationalization at AdtU by inspiring academics and staff to get involved in international
endeavors and gain the advantages of a thorough international education.

Introduction






Internal Quality Assurance Cell, an
internal quality assurance mechanism practiced in the University, is conceived
as a mechanism to build and ensure a quality culture at the institutional
level.Assam down town University has established its Internal Quality
Assurance Cell (IQAC) in 2018, following the recommendations of UGC and NAAC.
The primary objective of IQAC is to establish a system that promotes conscious,
consistent, and catalytic improvement in the overall performance of the
institution. The IQAC functions as a significant part of the Institution and
strives to achieve the objective of enhancing quality and sustaining
development.










Aims and Objectives








To develop a system for conscious, consistent
and catalytic action to improve the academic and administrative performance of
the institution.


To promote measures for institutional
functioning towards quality enhancement through internalization of quality
culture and institutionalization of best practices.









Strategies






Ensuring timely, efficient and
progressive performance of academic, administrative and financial tasks.
The relevance and quality of
academic and research programmes.
Equitable access to and
affordability of academic programmes for various sections of society.
Optimization and integration of
modern methods of teaching and learning.
The credibility of evaluation
procedures.
Ensuring the adequacy,
maintenance and functioning of the support structure and services.
Research sharing and networking
with other institutions across the globe.










Functions






Development and application of
quality parameters for various academic and administrative activities of the
institution.
Facilitating the creation of a
learner-centric environment conducive to quality education and faculty
maturation to acquire the skills required for participatory teaching and
learning process.
Organize feedback sessions with
students, parents and other stakeholders on quality-related institutional
processes.
Promoting information on various
quality parameters of higher education.
To ensure the credibility of
evaluation procedures.
Organization of inter and intra
institutional workshops, seminars on quality related themes and promotion of
quality circles.
Documentation of various
programmes and activities to enhance the overall quality of participation.
To act as a nodal agency of the
Institution for coordinating quality-related activities, including adoption and
dissemination of best practices.
Development and maintenance of
the institutional database through MIS for the purpose of enriching the
institutional quality.
Development of Quality Culture
in the institution.
Preparation of Annual Quality
Assurance Report (AQAR) as per the guidelines and parameters of NAAC.










Benefits






Ensure clarity and focus in
institutional functioning towards quality enhancement.
Ensure internalization of the
quality culture.
Ensure enhancement and
coordination amongst various activities of the institution and institutionalize
all good practices.
Provide a sound basis for
decision-making to improve institutional functioning.
The credibility of evaluation
procedures.
Act as a dynamic system for
quality changes in HEIs.
Build an organized methodology
of documentation and internal communication.

Allocation and Utilization of Computer Laboratories for Academic Session 2026–27

(View Details)


Allocation and Utilization of Computer Laboratories for Academic Session 2026–27

Dear Sir/Madam

This is to inform you that the computer laboratories have been allocated to the respective Faculties of Study for conducting regular practical classes during the Academic Session 2026–27. The laboratory allocation details are attached herewith for your reference.

(Download Attachment)

The following guidelines may kindly be noted:

The allocated laboratory will be given first preference for utilization by the respective Faculty of Study for conducting its scheduled practical classes.
All computer laboratories are considered University resources and may be utilized by students and faculties of other Schools, subject to availability and with prior coordination, ensuring that the regular academic activities of the assigned Faculty are not affected.
In case a computer laboratory is assigned to more than one Faculty of Study, the concerned Faculties are requested to mutually coordinate and finalize the laboratory schedule prior to scheduling practical classes to ensure the effective utilization of the laboratory and to avoid scheduling conflicts.
The Common Computer Centre shall remain open for use by all Faculties, staffs and students, subject to availability and the applicable usage schedule.
The IT Cell may utilize any of the computer laboratories for conducting Computer-Based Tests (CBTs) or other University-approved external examinations whenever required. In such cases, the concerned Faculty/School will be informed well in advance to facilitate necessary academic adjustments.

Your cooperation in ensuring the optimal utilization and effective management of the University computer laboratories is highly appreciated.

For any queries or clarification regarding the laboratory allocation, kindly contact the IT Cell.

Thank you.

Application for Convocation

(View Details)


Application for Convocation

The link to apply for the Convocation-2024 is available in A-Connect App and the last date of application would be September 15, 2024.

Guidelines for uploading passport photo in the convocation application form:

1) The photograph should be in colour and of the size of 2 inch x 2 inch (51mm x51
mm). Maximum Size 100 KB
2) The photograph must be in uniform and must not wear colored or dark glasses
during the snap.
3) The photo print should be clear and with continuous tone quality. Photograph should have:-

frontal view of full face, eyes open.
present full head from top of hair to bottom of chin. The head should be in the centre of the frame.
have a background of plain white or off-white.
not have any distracting shadows on the face or on the background.

4) Head should face the camera directly and should not tilt or turned. Photo must show both
edges of the face clearly.
5) The eyes must be clearly visible and must not be covered by hairs or eye glass frames.
6) Head coverings are not permitted except for religious reasons, but the facial features from
bottom of chin to top of forehead and both edges of the face must be clearly shown.
7) The expression on the face should look natural.

Photograph not taken by the aforementioned instructions will not be considered and ADTU
will not be responsible if certificates are not ready prior to convocation date due to this lapse on
the part of the students.



By Order

Controller of Examinations

Guidelines for uploading passport photo in the convocation application form:

1) The photograph should be in colour and of the size of 2 inch x 2 inch (51mm x51
mm). Maximum Size 100 KB
2) The photograph must be in uniform and must not wear colored or dark glasses
during the snap.
3) The photo print should be clear and with continuous tone quality. Photograph should have:-

frontal view of full face, eyes open.â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹
present full head from top of hair to bottom of chin. The head should be in the centre of the frame.
have a background of plain white or offâ€white.
not have any distracting shadows on the face or on the background.

4) Head should face the camera directly and should not tilt or turned. Photo must show both
edges of the face clearly.
5) The eyes must be clearly visible and must not be covered by hairs or eye glass frames.
6) Head coverings are not permitted except for religious reasons, but the facial features from
bottom of chin to top of forehead and both edges of the face must be clearly shown.
7) The expression on the face should look natural.

Important Security Notice - Do not share ERP (Academic and Examination) portal login details

Important Security Notice - Do not share ERP (Academic and Examination) portal login details

Dear all,
I am writing to inform you all about a critical security issue that we have observed recently. We have received reports of individuals contacting employees via email or message, requesting their ERP portal login credentials.
We want to remind you that it is essential that you do not share your login details with anyone, even if they claim to be from the IT cell or any other department. Please note that IT cell will never ask you to share your login credentials via email or message.
If you receive any such requests for your login credentials, please change your password immediately and report it to the IT cell. We will investigate and take appropriate action to ensure the security of our systems.
Thank you for your cooperation and for helping us keep our systems secure.

Regards,
IT Cell, ADTU

The "Annals of Multidisciplinary Research, Innovation and Technology (AMRIT)”, a research journal published by the Assam down town University online has received the ISSN (International Standard Serial Number) from the ISSN National Centre, India. The Journal ISSN is 2583-4657. The first issue of the journal (Volume 1 Issue 1, 2022) can be seen in the AdtU official website. This achievement of the university will go a long way in improving the standard and quality of the journal. The Editorial Board and the Publisher of the journal seek cooperation from all concerned for the upward growth of the journal and invite articles from the authors at any time for publication as per the guidelines of the journal.

Important Announcement Related to Convocation 2022

(View Details)


Important Announcement Related to Convocation 2022

In continuation of the Convocation Notice, a few points were added for the students to apply for the convocation in 2022. The points are mentioned for your information and circulation.



1. The students from the batches ending 2020 and 2021 who graduated from the university in their respective graduating year and have not applied for convocation may now apply only through ERP.

2. The students from the batches ending 2020 and 2021 who graduated after appearing in the compartmental examination must apply for convocation through the ERP portal.

3. The students from the batches ending 2020 and 2021 who graduated from the university but never applied for convocation may apply for convocation through ERP. However, if these categories of students are not able to apply through ERP because their names were moved to Alumni List or for some other causes may report the same to their respective PC. The PCs may inform the CoE office and IT Office for Solution.

4. The students from the batches ending before 2020 and not applied for Convocation or passed out recently may apply for convocation this time manually. These categories of students may apply through a form available with the Students' Help Desk on the ground floor of A Block attaching documents and a passport photograph.

5. The students of MSc Nursing and BSc. Post Basic Nursing may apply for Convocation manually by filling up the forms available with the Students' Help Desk on the ground floor of A Block attaching documents and a passport photograph.

6. All the students for the ending batch of 2022 may apply for convocation only through the ERP portal.

dtVL Ideation 2.0: Inviting Innovators and Startups to avail INTEREST FREE loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs





Title: dtVL Ideation 2.0: Inviting Innovators and Startups to avail INTEREST FREE loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs



down town Venture Labs calls for applications from Innovators, students, faculty members, Startups and aspiring entrepreneurs for availing soft loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs and incubation facility.



The proposals should be submitted along with a presentation in pdf/ppt format in the link given below and should contain details about the idea or innovation, business model/revenue model, competitive advantage, traction (If any), Founders' details and most importantly a plan of action for next 12 months including financial projections.



Salient Features:



a) The program is sector agnostic and hence no restriction in terms of sector or industry verticals. Anyone with any innovation or Startup idea can apply for this program.

b) Winner/s will receive Interest Free loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs for a duration of 12 months from the date of disbursement.



The applicants shall have to undergo 2 rounds of evaluation. Those Startups/Individuals who qualify in the screening round will be called for pitch presentations online.



Interested Individuals and Startups are requested to Click here to apply



Last date for idea submission is 12th March, 2022.

Event Name- TIDE 2.0: Inviting Application for Funding opportunities



down town Venture Labs, AdtU; supported under Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs (TIDE 2.0) by MeitY, GoI calls for applications from aspiring Tech Innovators with disruptive innovations in healthcare, Education and other important areas for availing funding and incubation support under the following categories.

PARTING WORDS FROM THE HONORABLE VICE CHANCELLOR

(View Details)


PARTING WORDS FROM THE HONORABLE VICE CHANCELLOR

To

The University Fraternity.



Dear all,

As I lay down the Vice-Chancellorship of Assam down town University today, kindly allow me to share certain thoughts with you.

We have all seen how the threat of corona-virus has forced us to take extraordinary   measures across the nation. The uncomfortable quietness   has indeed   induced a thorough introspection in me too. Looking back,  my years at AdtU had the elements of enormous challenges. But the cooperation of all turned it into a satisfying and enjoyable experience. In this connection, I must also make special mention of the esteemed trustees, the distinguished members of the Governing Body, Board of Management and Academic Council, all the teachers and employees of the University. From the strict adherence of academic calendar to the timely declaration of results, from successful ventures of NAAC accreditation to ISO certification, from implementation of digital classes to digital declaration of results, the journey was one of immense satisfaction.

The credit for this must be accorded to the entire University fraternity. Please accept my heartfelt gratitude to all of you on this count.

I am sure that our dear University will rise to new height with the synergy of your similar efforts.

Thanking you,



Prof. (Dr.) Amarjyoti  Choudhury

Vice Chancellor,

Assam down town University.

Invitation-Workshop on GAMESPEED AND RAMP TRAINING

Invitation-Workshop on GAMESPEED AND RAMP TRAINING

Respected Sir/MadamWarm greetings  I have the immense pleasure to inform you that, Assam down town University in collaboration with Transformers Academy of Fitness, Guwahati & Gayo Fitness Academy is conducting a two  days hands on workshop on GAMESPEED AND RAMP TRAINING  Dates 15th and 16th October 2019 The resource person for this course is IAN JEFFREY-  Strength and Conditioning ExpertSenior Lecturer ,Faculty of Life Sciences and Education, University of South Wales, Pontypridd, Cardiff, Newport The RAMP warm-up was developed by Ian Jeffreys, it has proven to be the most effective warm-up for athletes and is used by many elite coaches around the world.The acronym ‘RAMP’ stands for Raise, Activate, Mobilize, Potentiate. The Science Behind The RAMP Warm-UPWhile generally accepted as an integral part of every training session, the traditional processes of warming up have been the subject of surprisingly few quality research studies. Consequently, even when viewed solely as short term preparation, many generally accepted practices are based more on supposition than real evidence. This has led to increasing numbers of coaches to question traditional beliefs and investigate various methodologies that are able to optimise warm-up procedures.Today, warm-up procedures are evolving and new scientific research and practical evidence are being integrated into means and methods that have the capacity to significantly enhance the athlete’s warm-up.I am sure the students and the faculty members will get a enriching platform to share and learn from the expertIn this regard I would like to invite you to the inauguration ceremony of the program to be held on Tuesday 15th of October 2019 and will be very much glad if you can make your honorable presence and grace the occasion.  Venue- Auditorium 1 above JironeeTime- 10:30am Thanking you   --Dr. Abhijit Dutta (PT)Associate DeanFaculty of Paramedical SciencesAssam down town UniversityPanikhaiti, GuwahatiAssammob-8638029986

INVIGILATION GUIDELINES



Assam down town University

Gandhinagar, Panikhaiti, Guwahati-26

(Permission Granted Via The ASSAM ACT. NO. VIII OF 2010, Gazette No. LGL9/2010/11)



INVIGILATION GUIDELINES



1. Invigilators need to be present in the Examination hall at least 15 minutes before the start of the exam.

2. Invigilators are to collect the answer scripts 10 minutes prior to the Start of the Examination.

3. Students are to be instructed by the invigilators not to keep any printed or written material with them and not to write anything on the question paper which leads to malpractice. The students must be asked to leave their belongings including mobile phones.

4. The answer scripts are to be distributed by the invigilators 10 minutes before the commencement of the Examination and ask the students to fill all the details in the answer scripts.

5. Invigilators are requested to maintain silence in the examination hall, so as to provide conducive environment for the smooth conduct of the Examination.

6. Invigilators are requested not to use mobile phones inside the Examination hall except any emergency cases.

7. Invigilators are to check whether the students have occupied their allotted seats as per the seating arrangements.

8. Invigilators are to verify the ID card/ Admit Card of the students in the Examination hall.

9. The invigilators are required to sign with date in the main answer scripts in the space provided. The number on the main answer book is to be mentioned in the candidatesâ€™ attendance sheet and the candidateâ€™s signature should be obtained in the attendance sheet.

10. Invigilators need to move around in the Examination hall to prevent indiscipline / any type of malpractice.

11. Invigilators are not to leave the Examination hall unless a reserve occupies his/her place as per the instructions of the officer-in-charge.

12. Swapping of Duties without the notice of the Examination Officer in Charge is not permitted.

13. Other faculty members except the invigilators are not allowed to enter into other Examination halls without the consent of the concerned Hall Invigilator.

14. Once the examination is completed, answer scripts are to be collected by the concerned Invigilator from the students and should be handed over to the Examination Officer in Charge. The invigilator will be held responsible for any loss of the answer scripts. Invigilators are requested to leave the examination hall after the examination only of answer scripts bundles when the packing are over.

15. In case of any discrepancies, the matter may be brought to the notice of Examination Officer in Charge.

Application for Grand of Seed Money

Respected All,





Assam down town University has a provision to grant seed money as a start up for research projects to be undertaken by the faculty members to pursue research in various areas. The aim of the scheme is to strengthen the research activity especially among the young faculty members which will act as a catalyst for them to apply to the various funding agencies for major grants.



Research proposals are invited from the faculty members working at Assam down town University in the format provided. The faculty members are requested to submit research proposals for the seed money for research work in hard copy as well as soft copy to Mr. Debojit Bhattacharya, Deputy Administrative Officer, Assam down town University on or before 30th April, 2019 (email : debojit@downtowngroup.in) and a copy to the Prof. H. K. Das, Pro Vice Chancellor and Chairperson, Internal Research Review Committee (IRRC) (email: hkdas1964@gmail.com).



The norms and guidelines of the schemes/ seed money for research works are given below to help the faculty in the preparation of proposals.

1. The project should be completed within a period of one year.

2. The proposal should clearly state the objectives; indicating the methodology, work plan, expected results, outcome of the project along with the budget estimate. The budget estimate should break down on half yearly basis.

3. The maximum grant available for the start up for research project is Rs. 40,000/- under the following heads.



Ã˜ Chemicals/ Consumable/Minor equipments and Contingency etc for the duration of the project. The budget estimate should provide the details under the heads such as consumables/ chemicals/ reagents and contingency etc.



4. All the purchase/ expenditure related to the mini project will be carried out by the Purchase/ Finance Section of the University subject to the approval of the Internal Review Research Committee.



5. Research proposal from young faculty members and in collaboration with other faculty members from within and other departments (intra and inter departmental) involving interdisciplinary research areas will be given preference.



6. Principal Investigators who have already been granted research grants are not eligible to apply.



7. The selection of the project will be based on peer review and presentation of short listed proposals before an expert committee.

8. On receipt of approval letter from the authority, the Principal Investigator is requested to implement the project and submit the acceptance letter to the authority.



9. The Principal Investigator should submit monthly progress report along with the statement of expenditure etc to the Internal Research Review Committee.



10. A bound copy of the final report of the work done with details to be submitted to the Research Cell of the University on completion of the project.

Summary:

Biology was descriptive in nature which eventually became quantitative with the enhancement, development and integration of various subjects from material science. International Admissions

Assam down town University has been a pioneer of modern global education that inspires its students to think critically, learn across disciplinary boundaries, engage in research and focus on values of highest order. The journey of the university started with down town Charity Trust that established this institution in 2010 nestled in the scenic surroundings of Panikhaiti, Chandrapur, Guwahati. Overview

The Directorate of Innovation, Startup & Acceleration (DISA) at Assam down town University is dedicated to fostering a dynamic ecosystem for innovation entrepreneurship, and business growth. Its mission is to nurture early-stage startups, promote cutting-edge research, and accelerate the commercialization of novel ideas. DISA encourages innovative thinking among students, faculty and the broader community through ideation sessions, hackathons and workshops.











Vision & Mission



Vision


Our vision is to transform Assam down town University into a leading hub of innovation and entrepreneurship, driving technological advancements, economic development, and sustainable business practices. We strive to create a thriving community where innovative thinking is encouraged, and entrepreneurs are equipped with the resources, mentorship, and opportunities they need to succeed and contribute to global challenges.






Mission

The mission of the Directorate of Innovation, Startup & Acceleration (DISA) at Assam down town University is to foster a dynamic and supportive ecosystem for innovation, entrepreneurship, and business growth. We aim to nurture early-stage startups, promote cutting-edge research, and accelerate the commercialization of novel ideas, empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to make a positive impact on society.









Initiatives

The DISA has a few dedicated initiatives for students aspiring to undertake innovation and entrepreneurship activities.





Innovation Grant




Entrepreneurship loan





Campus iDEATION




Campus Bazaar




Campus Stall












Innovation Grant
Innovation Grant for students to undertake Innovation and Entrepreneurship

Maximum amount up to ₹25,000



Open to all AdtU students with innovative entrepreneurial ideas.


Available for academic projects as well as independent Startup ideas

Application Process



The application process commences at the beginning of each semester.


Students can apply through the dedicated link on the A Connect app of AdtU.
















Entrepreneurship loan
Entrepreneurship loan for students to undertake Innovation and Entrepreneurship

Maximum amount up to ₹50,000



Open to all AdtU students with entrepreneurial ideas or students pursuing any business.


2. Duration of loan term: 6 months


0% Interest rate


Application Process



Application for the Students Entrepreneurship loan is open throughout the year.


Students can apply through the dedicated link on the A Connect app of AdtU.

















Campus iDEATION
Campus iDEATION is an initiative by down town Venture Labs, the Technology Business Incubator of AdtU, designed to empower students who are eager to explore innovation and entrepreneurship while pursuing their studies at AdtU.


Benefits




Funding support for prototype/product development and business through existing schemes such as innovation grants and entrepreneurship loans.


Co-working space provided for selected student incubates



Training in business development and startup financials


Technical mentorship for product development



Mentorship from experienced industry professionals and successful startup founders.











FREE Company incorporation



FREE IPR processing



Legal and compliance support


Connections with other incubators and accelerators


Training and mentorship to apply for relevant government schemes


Linkage with investors for eligible Student startups













Application Process



Funding support for prototype/product development and business through existing schemes such as innovation grants and entrepreneurship loans.


Students can apply through the dedicated link on the A Connect app of AdtU.

















Campus Bazaar
Campus Bazaar, an initiative by down town Venture Labs - AdtU, was established to create a platform for student entrepreneurs to sell their products every Friday and foster a culture of 'Earn while you learn.' AdtU recognizes the importance of entrepreneurship as a crucial skill for all students, regardless of their future career paths.



Benefits



Open to All Students: Sell anything from fast food, juice, stationary items, gift items, electronics item and more.


Flexible Participation: Participate individually or in groups of up to 4 members.


Free Stalls: Stalls are provided at no extra charge by the university.


Entrepreneurial Experience: Gain hands-on experience in entrepreneurship.


Special Opportunities: Take advantage of opportunities to set up stalls outside the campus on special occasions.








Application Process



Application for Campus Bazaaris open throughout the year.


Students can apply through the dedicated link on the A Connect app of AdtU.


















Campus Stall
Campus Stall, an initiative by down town Venture Labs - AdtU, is designed to provide a permanent platform for student entrepreneurs to sell their products daily. Essentially, it’s a student-run shop located on campus where you can sell a wide range of items. This initiative allows you to gain real-world business experience and develop essential entrepreneurial skills.



Benefits



Open to All Students of AdtU: All students are welcome to participate and sell their products.


Sell a Wide Range of Items: Flexibility to sell anything from food and beverages to stationery and gift items.




Free Stall Space:The university provides stall space at no cost; students only need to cover utility charges.


Entrepreneurship Loan: Students running a Campus Stall can apply for an entrepreneurship loan to support their business.


















Application Process



Application for Campus Stall is open throughout the year.


Students can apply through the dedicated link on the A Connect app of AdtU.




















Innovations


















View more









down town Venture Labs foundation
An independent Technology Business Incubator (TBI) called the down town Venture Labs foundation operates under the auspices of DISA. Registered as a section 8 company, down town Venture Labs foundation provides a supportive environment for early-stage startups, offering a range of services including mentorship, funding, and access to state-of-the-art facilities. The incubator is dedicated to nurturing innovative ideas and helping startups scale their operations to achieve commercial success.

Explore our diverse incubation programs and initiatives further by clicking the button Visit here









Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC)
An independent Technology Business Incubator (TBI) called the down town Venture Labs foundation Assam down town University boasts a fully functioning Institution Innovation Council (IIC) that promotes a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship on campus and beyond. The IIC, under the leadership of Prof. Dr. Sunandan Baruah, achieved a remarkable rating of 3.5 stars for the academic year 2021-22, making it one of the highest performing private institutions in the Northeast region. Over the past few years, in coordination with the incubation center dtVL, the council has organized numerous idea/startup pitching sessions, ideathons, hackathons, capacity-building workshops on innovation, entrepreneurship and intellectual property rights (IPR) and various training sessions on prototyping, idea validation, design thinking and business model/revenue model etc. The IIC has also facilitated interactions with young entrepreneurs and investors from the local and national startup communities. Furthermore, the IIC established a Student Innovation Fund with a substantial corpus to financially support aspiring innovators and entrepreneurs at the University.











E-Cell
Assam down town University has established a student-led and student-managed E-Cell to foster innovation and entrepreneurship through hands-on learning. This E-Cell is driven by a dedicated team of students who take on various roles within the organization. The E-Cell aims to nurture a culture of innovation and support the creation of innovation-driven business enterprises within the student community at AdtU and beyond, in collaboration with the down town Venture Labs foundation and the University.

Welcome to Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science

The Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science of Assam down town University is the centre of excellence in Pharmaceutical Education and Research of Northeast India. It is currently offering courses viz. D.Pharm, B.Pharm, M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics & Pharmacology) and PhD program. All the programs offered by Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science of AdtU are approved by the PCI, New Delhi. The Faculty is equipped with sophisticated laboratories, advanced instrument facilities and digital class rooms etc. The entire academic and research activities are carried out under the supervision of experienced faculty members. The Faculty of Study has been maintaining a record of 100% placement since the inception.

Show More


Vision & Mission







Our Vision


The Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science at AdtU envisions attaining excellence in pharmaceutical education, research, innovation and professional leadership through the integration of cutting-edge technology in service of humankind.




Our Mission




To impart Pharmacy education and conduct groundbreaking research for the North East region, while concurrently contributing to the augmentation of the nation's prosperity.
To cultivate a vast knowledge repository emphasizing scientific studies by unlocking the potential of regional resources.
To build human resources, fostering entrepreneurship, and cultivating networks with reputable institutions for comprehensive development.

Welcome to the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science, Assam down town University (AdtU). As an integral component of the University, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences is dedicated to cultivating young healthcare professionals who are poised to tackle future challenges while upholding the values, culture, and ethics essential for societal prosperity. In its fourteen years of existence, the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science has evolved into a mature and technically proficient academic hub, carving a distinctive niche in academia. Timely and advanced research initiatives with currently changing educational landscape and propelling the institution to new heights. The students of the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science benefit from a dynamic mix of experienced, and enthusiastic faculty members. Beyond delivering a comprehensive education, our faculty ensures that students are nurtured into confident individuals capable of tackling challenges in both personal and professional spheres. Digital classrooms, well-equipped laboratories with relevant and sophisticated instruments, robust infrastructure, 100% placement opportunities, and guidance from qualified and experienced faculty members collectively position the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science as a leading Pharmacy institute of North East India.

Continuing to build upon its rich history and tradition of excellence, the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science offers quality diploma (D.Pharm), undergraduate (B.Pharm), and postgraduate (M.Pharm in Pharmacology and Pharmaceutics) and PhD degree  programs. These programs provide students with the requisite education and skills, complemented by excellent infrastructure and resources, to thrive in their careers in Pharmacy. Our strong industry ties significantly contribute to enhancing the technical and personal skills of our students, leading to successful placements. Many of our alumni are currently serving as responsible professionals in various sectors in India and abroad. We are steadfast in our commitment to maintaining the pinnacle of standards in pharmacy education and research. Our facilities, including Sophisticated Instrumentation Facilities, the Centre of Research on Ethnomedicine, and the Centre of Excellence in Research, along with CCSEA approved animal House facilities, empower students, faculty members, PhD scholars, and researchers to pursue advanced studies.

To embrace the joy of gaining knowledge, we invite aspiring pharmacy professionals to join and become the part of the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science, AdtU, where students from every corner of the globe are warmly embraced.
